decision_context.reason: The unchanged exact-SIMD candidate produced a repeatable approximately 6.5 percent complete-call component benefit. General compute improvement is useful even though the original 1.10x planning gate failed.
decision_context.interpretation: Validation quantifies the unchanged candidate; it does not retroactively pass the original planning gate and defines no replacement minimum speed gate.

variants.original_fp64_packed: native/libblind_strided_v4.so through NativeDwell, including caller packing
variants.stable_fp32_fftw: fft32/libfft32_fftw.so through the natural-stride V4 port

timing.order: three-way cyclic counterbalance by receiver-case ordinal and repetition
timing.scope: complete caller thread CPU and wall time; original FP64 includes np.ascontiguousarray receiver packing
timing.aggregation: sum of per-receiver medians, reported directly without multiplying ratios

scientific_gates.simd_vs_stable_fp32: every non-timing DwellResult field must be exactly equal on every receiver case and repeat
scientific_gates.stable_and_simd_vs_original_fp64: no lost or additional positive top result under the frozen 2 us circular timing and 8 kHz CFO identity rule
scientific_gates.repeatability: each variant must return an identical non-timing result across all three repetitions
scientific_gates.input: all IQ file hashes verified and memory unchanged

reporting: Report total original-FP64-to-SIMD and incremental stable-FP32-to-SIMD CPU/wall gains.
